subject: wo-exp-pri
title: WO.EXP.PRI.------PRI.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 33 (WM-9). WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; PRI-INFO (principle information) is the partner. From the subject: UNI-PI, TR (transformation) and AFI (affinity insight). From TR: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From LK-IMP: AFL (affinity alignment). From AFI: MOT-DY, SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and RIT-DY (ritual dynamics). From MOT-DY: CULT-SOLD (culture solidification). From CULT-SOLD: AGT (agreement). The page text speaks of "the concept of affinity alignment" and of the "reality of principle information".
